posts.topic_title: saw updated holography exhibit @ MIT Museum
posts.author: favalora
posts.post_subject: saw updated holography exhibit @ MIT Museum
posts.content_md:
It seems that all (?) of the usual holograms on exhibit at the MIT Museum have been replaced with other pieces. Evidently the show is "The Jeweled Net" - June '12 - Sep '13... and it was an interesting and inspirational change of pace. I saw that Javid Khan had a work up, and several that were produced by Geola. Visitors first encounter "Hand in Jewels" when they walk in. Even the LLoyd Cross multiplex Kiss hologram was gone for this show, replaced with an apple hologram.

[http://web.mit.edu/museum/exhibitions/holography.html](http://web.mit.edu/museum/exhibitions/holography.html)

g
